summary: EveryConnect is a DSH plugin that connects messaging platforms like WeChat Claw/iLink to DSH, and provides settings plus command-based workflows to synchronize session conversations.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is primarily an external-services integration connector that links DSH with messaging platforms (initially WeChat via Claw/iLink, with QQ/WeCom planned), as shown by its package metadata declaring a DSH plugin bundle/client and README sections describing platform adapters, message routing, settings page, and command-driven session workflows. It focuses on bridging platform messages to DSH agents and returning replies, with additional media handling for audio/files and lifecycle/networked connector behavior.
